title: What rock and roll meant, and the white musicians now
summary: To Ridgley rock and roll meant white audiences; once black bands played white dances, now white musicians back black singers; Bobby Cure and shared rhythm.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand
